mais01: Start with the frontal view. The tibia, fibula, and TAY-lus form the mortise, and the joint space should be even all the way around.
mais02: On the medial side, the deltoid ligament anchors the TAY-lus to the medial malleolus. Between the tibia and fibula sits the sin-dez-MO-sis.
mais04: First, the medial side fails. The deep deltoid ligament ruptures, or the medial malleolus breaks.
mais07: On the ankle film, look for a widened medial clear space and a widened tibiofibular clear space, with no fracture of the lateral malleolus.
